notes.title: Modules Update! (1.7)
notes.content:
Modules:
The module system has been completely rewritten!
-Added a inventory system for modules
-You can now own multiple modules of the same class
-You can now equip multiple non-unique modules of the same class
-Modules can now have up to 3 random attributes
-Wafers can now be used to polish modules, randomizing the values of the module attributes
-PCBs can now be used to refactor modules, randomizing all of its attributes
-You can now scrap modules to receive a PCB
-Chests now have a 10% chance of having a module instead of a resource
-Added 6 new modules
-Removed the Equalizer

Tasks:
-You can no longer receive image, music and video tasks on the Gamer Universe

Uploads:
-Upload requests no longer grants 10% performance boost upon completion
-Upload requests now grant diamonds upon completion
-Upload requests no longer appear if your current level is lower than your highest achieved level

Research:
-Added Soldering: Allows PCBs to be crafted and scrapped with no losses
-GadgetDeals no longer partially refunds component upgrades, but instead add a 20% discount to components
-Module Specialization now requires 1500 module score, from 1000
-Removed Kludge

Components:
-Increased the base price of the CPU from 500 to 1k

QoL:
-Increased the font size and improved readability in multiple texts

Misc:
-Updated engine to 4.3
-Post Processing is now finally available, but disabled by default

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.6
notes.content:
Manufactory:
-The manufactory system received a major rework
-You now have a maximum of 10 assembly line slots that you can use to produce either electronics, gpu boosters, network boosters, or cpu boosters
-Modifications were removed

Components:
-You can now bulk upgrade the GPU, Network and CPU components
-Reworked the price formula for the GPU and Network components to speed up early game
-Increased the attributes given by the GPU and Network components in early game

Overclocking:
-You can now bulk upgrade the Overclocker
-Reworked the price formula for the Overclocker
-Decreased the initial cost for the Overclocker

Research:
-Added a new research that allows the manufactory to produce CPU components
-Moved Drivers to Tier 1 between the Overclocker and the Manufactory
-Moved Moore's Law to Tier 2
-Removed researches related to modifications

Milestones:
-Added a new milestone that unlocks new assembly line slots
-Moved CPU Clock to Tier 2 as a result of the research changes

Modules:
-The Auto Clicker now has 5 levels, and each level increases its tracking speed
-The Eliminator now has 5 levels, and each level increases its tracking speed
-Updated modules display

Misc:
-Reduced experience scaling to x2 (from x2.5)
-Reduced file size scaling with level to x2 (from x2.5)
-Drivers had their base file size reduced

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.5
notes.content:
Universes:
-Added 7 parallel universes you can discover with unique mechanics and twists
-Universes can be completed by doing a New Game+, rewarding you with powerful benefits
-Power and Curiosity now grants +100% to performance and +500% science points respectively

Achievements:
-Added a new achievement

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug that caused ghost hacks to be equipped
-Fixed a bug that would causes talents to not be unlocked after a tech research
-The Skip hack now properly skips upload progress and add to your uploaded data
